description: Compare House (H.R. 8800) vs Senate (S. 4784) text for a section number or a topic. Returns which chamber has the section, whether the text differs, and the diff URL.

limit.description: Max sections when comparing a topic (default 12, max 25).

topic.description: Topic slug or keyword to compare across chambers (e.g. "pay raise", "foci").

name: compare_house_senate
